text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 广播塔步道.
Environment: Walking path beside a radio transmission tower, coastal vegetation, tower foundation and open skyline.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 2 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create a two-panel horizontal set of clearly opposite viewpoints of the SAME sea broadcast tower walkway. Image 1 is geometric plan, image 2 style reference. LEFT A: camera on the outer observation platform looking along catwalk TOWARD the white tower. RIGHT B: camera at the tower door looking OUT along that same catwalk to the ocean platform, with the tower behind camera and therefore NOT visible. Maintain same railings and coastal rocks, soft grey daylight. No people. Never mirror or rotate objects; actually change camera position.
